rent_concept_authority.rule: Respondents exclude housing-authority/agency subsidies from contract rent; this donor does not observe pre-subsidy rent

semantics.acs_annual_reported_contract_rent: RNTP * ADJHSG / 1000000 * 12; annualized reported monthly contract rent, not observed pre-subsidy rent; out-of-universe blanks remain missing
semantics.acs_annual_property_tax: TAXAMT * ADJHSG / 1000000; already annual, no multiplication by 12
semantics.acs_social_security_income: Reference person's combined SSP * ADJINC / 1000000; no component split
semantics.acs_retirement_income: Reference person's combined RETP * ADJINC / 1000000; no private/public or taxable/exempt split
semantics.tenure_type: TEN 1 and 2 pooled as OWNED_WITH_MORTGAGE for legacy predictor compatibility only; native TEN retained
semantics.household_weight: Housing-unit WGTP design weight, once per selected reference person
semantics.household_size: Linked person count, required to equal NP
semantics.rent_observed: Finite RNTP in occupied TEN=3 housing unit and FRNTP=0; means unallocated reported rent, not verified unsubsidized rent
semantics.property_tax_observed: Finite TAXAMT in occupied TEN=1/2 housing unit and FTAXP=0

selection: All occupied housing units; vacant and group-quarters rows excluded explicitly; no recipient-based subset
sampling: Existing archived joint rent/property-tax target-specific allocation-mask union and deterministic 10000-row cap; original sampler salts retained
